stem: It is claimed that 30% of packets of Froogum contain a free gift. Andre thinks that the actual proportion is less than 30% and he decides to carry out a hypothesis test at the 5% significance level. He buys 20 packets of Froogum and notes the number of free gifts he obtains.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: State null and alternative hypotheses for the test.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Use a binomial distribution to find the probability of a Type I error.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.stem: Andre finds that 3 of the 20 packets contain free gifts.
